id: 06_Emergencies in the Chemistry Laboratory ACS College Safety Video 6
title: 化学实验室的应急处置（国内版）
source_doc: course/ACS College Lab Safety Series/06_Emergencies in the Chemistry Laboratory ACS College Safety Video 6.md
author_source: project/ACS College Lab Safety Series/06_Emergencies in the Chemistry Laboratory ACS College Safety Video 6（国内版）/src.py

points.K1: 防护装备按风险评估来选
points.K2: 四步法的最后一步：应急准备
points.K6: 四类常见情况，先告诉老师
points.K9: 刷子簸箕清扫，进专用容器
points.K10: 沾了化学品的碎玻璃要特殊处理
points.K11: 溅入眼睛：洗眼器持续冲洗
points.K12: 溅到手臂：水槽大量冲水
points.K18: 移开物品、围堵、听从撤离
points.K21: 可燃物：看标签和象形图
points.K24: 小火：扣上盖子隔绝空气
points.K27: 听老师指挥，自己也要会
points.K28: 撤离前：关电关气拉视窗

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室门口，身后墙上有洗眼器、灭火器标志，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a lab doorway in front of a wall with an eyewash sign and a fire extinguisher sign, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲化学实验室的应急处置。
overlay: 化学实验室的应急处置

shots.scene: 碎玻璃、溅到人身上、台面洒漏、火焰四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: broken glass, a splash on a person, a puddle on a bench, and a flame. No people.
shots.narration: 碎玻璃、溅到身上、洒漏、着火。

shots.scene: 阿杰在实验台前转身，手肘碰倒一只烧杯
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, in a lab coat and goggles, turns around at the bench and his elbow knocks a beaker off the edge.
shots.narration: 实验课上，阿杰转身碰倒了烧杯。

shots.scene: 烧杯在地上摔碎，液体溅开，阿杰愣住
shots.prompt_en: The beaker shatters on the floor and liquid splashes; the young male student freezes in surprise.
shots.narration: 玻璃碎了，液体也溅了出来。

shots.scene: 阿杰手足无措，旁边同学也围过来
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks around helplessly as classmates start walking over.
shots.narration: 他一下子慌了：先做什么？

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 应急，靠的是事先想好、平时练好。

shots.section_title: 防护装备按风险评估来选
shots.scene: 欣欣举着护目镜和手套，旁边是空白的风险评估表
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up safety goggles and gloves next to a blank risk assessment form on an easel.
shots.narration: 演示中的防护，都按风险评估来选。
overlay: 防护装备按风险评估来选

shots.section_title: 防护装备按风险评估来选
shots.scene: 空无试剂的实验台，打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: An empty lab bench with no chemical bottles, with a green check mark icon. No people.
shots.narration: 没有化学品的台前，才谈得上不穿防护。

shots.section_title: 四步法的最后一步：应急准备
shots.scene: 四个台阶图标，前三级打勾，第四级亮起
shots.prompt_en: Four step icons going up; the first three have green checks and the fourth step glows.
shots.narration: 安全四步，前三步做好了，
overlay: 四步法的最后一步：应急准备

shots.section_title: 四步法的最后一步：应急准备
shots.scene: 第四级台阶上放着急救箱和灭火器图标
shots.prompt_en: A first aid kit icon and a fire extinguisher icon sitting on the fourth step. No people.
shots.narration: 这一课讲最后一步：应急准备。

shots.scene: 两个小人图标：一个明知有警示还在操作，一个头上冒问号
shots.prompt_en: Two person pictograms: one ignoring a warning sign while working, the other with a question mark over its head. No people.
shots.narration: 出事往往两种：明知不安全还做，

shots.scene: 问号小人旁边的操作图标闪烁警示
shots.prompt_en: The pictogram with the question mark stands beside a flashing warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 或者根本不知道自己在冒险。

shots.scene: 前三级台阶挡住了两个事故图标
shots.prompt_en: The first three step icons form a wall that blocks the two accident pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 做好前三步，这些都能预防。

shots.scene: 仪器冒烟图标和灯泡熄灭的停电图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a smoking instrument and an icon of a light bulb going dark for a power outage. No people.
shots.narration: 可设备故障、突然停电，谁也躲不开。

shots.scene: 欣欣拍拍身旁的急救箱
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot pats a first aid kit on the bench beside it.
shots.narration: 所以，一定要提前做好应急准备。

shots.scene: 实验室墙上洗眼器、紧急喷淋、灭火器、急救箱依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash station, an emergency shower, a fire extinguisher and a first aid kit light up one by one along a lab wall. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室必须配齐应急设施，

shots.scene: 老李在给洗眼器做检查，手拿空白检查表
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tests an eyewash station and ticks a blank inspection sheet.
shots.narration: 并由学校定期检查。

shots.scene: 阿杰一进实验室就环顾四周，视线依次扫过各个设施
shots.prompt_en: The young male student enters the lab and looks around, his gaze sweeping across the eyewash, shower and extinguisher.
shots.narration: 每次进实验室，先看清它们在哪。

shots.section_title: 四类常见情况，先告诉老师
shots.scene: 四类情况图标围成一圈，中间是举手的小人
shots.prompt_en: Four emergency icons arranged in a circle around a pictogram of a person raising a hand. No people.
shots.narration: 碎玻璃、溅到身上、洒漏、着火，
overlay: 四类常见情况，先告诉老师

shots.section_title: 四类常见情况，先告诉老师
shots.scene: 阿杰举手大声呼叫，小研（助教）快步走来
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand and calls out; the female graduate student, working as teaching assistant, hurries over.
shots.narration: 无论哪种，第一时间告诉老师。

shots.scene: 台面上散落的破烧杯和破锥形瓶
shots.prompt_en: Broken pieces of a beaker and a conical flask scattered on a lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 碎玻璃很常见，算不上大事故，

shots.scene: 碎片边缘放大，闪着锋利的光
shots.prompt_en: A magnified view of a broken glass edge glinting sharply, with a small warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 但锋利的边缘，一碰就伤人。

shots.scene: 小研张开双臂拦住过道，地上有碎玻璃
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student spreads her arms to block the aisle where broken glass lies on the floor.
shots.narration: 碎玻璃在地上，先把这块区域隔开。

shots.scene: 踩过碎玻璃的鞋图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a shoe stepping onto broken glass, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别让人从上面踩过去。

shots.scene: 阿杰向小研报告，指着地面
shots.prompt_en: The young male student points at the floor while telling the female graduate student what happened.
shots.narration: 告诉老师，老师会帮你一起处理。

shots.section_title: 刷子簸箕清扫，进专用容器
shots.scene: 小研戴厚手套，用刷子和簸箕扫碎玻璃
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing thick gloves and goggles, sweeps the broken glass into a dustpan with a brush.
shots.narration: 用刷子和簸箕清扫，不徒手捡。
overlay: 刷子簸箕清扫，进专用容器

shots.section_title: 刷子簸箕清扫，进专用容器
shots.scene: 碎玻璃倒进专用碎玻璃收集箱
shots.prompt_en: Broken glass tipped from the dustpan into a sturdy dedicated broken glass box with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 倒进专用的碎玻璃收集箱。

shots.section_title: 刷子簸箕清扫，进专用容器
shots.scene: 碎玻璃扔进普通废纸篓的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of broken glass going into an ordinary paper wastebasket, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不扔进普通垃圾桶，免得伤到别人。

shots.section_title: 沾了化学品的碎玻璃要特殊处理
shots.scene: 沾着液体的碎玻璃，旁边化学品瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: Broken glass pieces wet with liquid, next to a chemical bottle icon with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 沾了化学品的碎玻璃，要特殊处理。
overlay: 沾了化学品的碎玻璃要特殊处理

shots.section_title: 沾了化学品的碎玻璃要特殊处理
shots.scene: 小研指着碎玻璃，向老周说明
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at the wet broken glass and explains to the older man.
shots.narration: 一定告诉老师，按化学品性质来处理。

shots.section_title: 溅入眼睛：洗眼器持续冲洗
shots.scene: 欣欣指着自己戴着的护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the safety goggles it is wearing.
shots.narration: 护目镜要一直戴着。
overlay: 溅入眼睛：洗眼器持续冲洗

shots.section_title: 溅入眼睛：洗眼器持续冲洗
shots.scene: 洗眼器标志和正在出水的洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash sign above a lab eyewash station with gentle streams of water flowing. No people.
shots.narration: 万一溅进眼睛，马上去洗眼器。

shots.section_title: 溅入眼睛：洗眼器持续冲洗
shots.scene: 阿杰俯身在洗眼器前冲眼，小研帮他撑开眼睑
shots.prompt_en: The young male student bends over the eyewash station rinsing his eyes while the female graduate student helps hold his eyelids open.
shots.narration: 撑开眼睑，用清水持续冲洗。

shots.section_title: 溅入眼睛：洗眼器持续冲洗
shots.scene: 沙漏图标，旁边眼睛图标被水流包围
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass icon beside an eye icon surrounded by flowing water. No people.
shots.narration: 要冲足够长时间，化学品会渗进组织。

shots.section_title: 溅入眼睛：洗眼器持续冲洗
shots.scene: 老周陪着阿杰走向门口，手里拿着电话
shots.prompt_en: The older man walks the young male student toward the door while holding a phone.
shots.narration: 冲洗之后，老师会安排就医。

shots.section_title: 溅到手臂：水槽大量冲水
shots.scene: 阿杰的前臂在水槽龙头下大量冲水
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds his forearm under a strong stream of water at the lab sink.
shots.narration: 溅到手或前臂，到水槽用大量水冲。
overlay: 溅到手臂：水槽大量冲水

shots.section_title: 溅到手臂：水槽大量冲水
shots.scene: 浸湿的衣袖被脱下的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wet shirt sleeve being taken off, with a drop icon on the fabric. No people.
shots.narration: 长袖被浸湿，脱掉或剪掉袖子，

shots.section_title: 溅到手臂：水槽大量冲水
shots.scene: 化学品从布料渗到皮肤的示意，被红叉
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of liquid soaking through fabric onto skin, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别让衣服里的化学品继续贴着皮肤。

shots.scene: 紧急喷淋标志和喷淋装置
shots.prompt_en: An emergency shower sign above an emergency safety shower with its pull handle. No people.
shots.narration: 水槽冲不干净，就用紧急喷淋。

shots.scene: 阿杰拉下喷淋拉手，站在水下
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pulls the shower handle and stands under the stream of water.
shots.narration: 拉下拉手，站在水下冲。

shots.scene: 被浸透的外衣丢到一旁的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a soaked lab coat being removed and set aside. No people.
shots.narration: 浸透的衣物要脱掉。

shots.scene: 大量水从喷淋头一下子落下
shots.prompt_en: A huge rush of water falling from the shower head all at once. No people.
shots.narration: 喷淋的水量很大，心里要有准备。

shots.scene: 手背上撒着一层白色粉末
shots.prompt_en: A hand with a thin layer of white powder on the back. No people.
shots.narration: 干的化学品落到皮肤上，

shots.scene: 用一张卡片把粉末从手背上刮掉
shots.prompt_en: A blank plastic card scrapes the white powder off the back of the hand. No people.
shots.narration: 先把大部分刮掉，再用水冲。

shots.scene: 药匙、卡片、学生证图标，旁边水滴清洁图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a spatula, a blank card and a blank student card, with a water drop cleaning icon beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 药匙、卡片都能用，用后洗干净。

shots.scene: 台面上量筒倒下，液体流开
shots.prompt_en: A graduated cylinder tipped over on a lab bench with liquid spreading across the surface. No people.
shots.narration: 液体洒在台面或地上，

shots.scene: 湿滑地面上滑倒的小人图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person slipping on a wet floor, with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 会带来多种隐患，比如地滑摔倒。

shots.scene: 小研提着应急处理箱走来
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student carries a spill response kit over to the bench.
shots.narration: 清理洒漏，一般由老师用应急处理箱。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在一旁，等待指示
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands back and waits for instructions.
shots.narration: 你能做的，是帮几件小事。

shots.scene: 阿杰向周围同学摆手示意远离
shots.prompt_en: The young male student waves nearby classmates away from the spill.
shots.narration: 先提醒附近的同学别靠近。

shots.scene: 阿杰举手报告小研
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand and reports to the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 确保有人报告老师。

shots.section_title: 移开物品、围堵、听从撤离
shots.scene: 阿杰把台面上的记录本和瓶子移开
shots.prompt_en: The young male student moves a notebook and bottles away from the edge of the spill.
shots.narration: 在安全的前提下，移开旁边的物品。
overlay: 移开物品、围堵、听从撤离

shots.section_title: 移开物品、围堵、听从撤离
shots.scene: 吸附材料在液体外围围成一圈
shots.prompt_en: A ring of absorbent material poured around the edge of a liquid spill. No people.
shots.narration: 受过培训的，可用吸附材料围住。

shots.section_title: 移开物品、围堵、听从撤离
shots.scene: 老周站在门口，示意大家听指挥
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands at the lab door and raises a hand to direct everyone.
shots.narration: 要不要撤离，由老师决定。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁一个小火苗图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a small flame icon.
shots.narration: 教学实验室着火不多，火也不大，

shots.scene: 小火苗图标旁边出现大的警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A large yellow warning triangle appears next to the small flame icon. No people.
shots.narration: 但风险很大，要预防，也要会应对。

shots.scene: 一个三角形，三边各有一个图标
shots.prompt_en: A triangle diagram with an icon on each side: a fuel can, an oxygen bubble and a spark. No people.
shots.narration: 燃烧要三样东西，叫火三角：

shots.scene: 三角形三边依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The three sides of the triangle light up one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 可燃物、氧化剂和点火源。

shots.section_title: 可燃物：看标签和象形图
shots.scene: 阿杰拿起试剂瓶，看空白标签上的象形图
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up a chemical bottle and studies the pictogram on its blank label.
shots.narration: 用每种化学品，先看标签是否易燃。
overlay: 可燃物：看标签和象形图

shots.section_title: 可燃物：看标签和象形图
shots.scene: 易燃象形图和氧化性象形图并排
shots.prompt_en: A flammable GHS pictogram and an oxidizer GHS pictogram side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 注意，易燃和氧化性的图标很像。

shots.section_title: 可燃物：看标签和象形图
shots.scene: 两个象形图下方，火焰底下多了一个圆圈被放大
shots.prompt_en: The two pictograms magnified, highlighting the circle under the flame in the oxidizer pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 火焰下面有个圈的，是氧化性。

shots.scene: 空气中漂浮的氧气小气泡图标
shots.prompt_en: Small oxygen bubble icons floating in the air around a lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 氧化剂呢？最常见的就在身边，

shots.scene: 可燃物图标被氧气泡包围
shots.prompt_en: A fuel icon surrounded by oxygen bubble icons. No people.
shots.narration: 就是空气里的氧气。

shots.scene: 火柴、燃气灯火焰、电火花三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a lit match, a gas burner flame and an electrical spark from a plug. No people.
shots.narration: 任何点火源都能引燃，

shots.scene: 易燃溶剂瓶靠近燃气灯的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a flammable solvent bottle placed next to a burner flame, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 常见的是明火，还有电火花。

shots.section_title: 小火：扣上盖子隔绝空气
shots.scene: 小研把大烧杯倒扣在台面一小簇火上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, in goggles and a lab coat, places a large beaker upside down over a tiny flame in a dish on the bench.
shots.narration: 受控的小火，用表面皿或大烧杯扣灭。
overlay: 小火：扣上盖子隔绝空气

shots.section_title: 小火：扣上盖子隔绝空气
shots.scene: 烧杯下火焰熄灭，氧气泡被挡在外面
shots.prompt_en: Under the inverted beaker the flame goes out; oxygen bubble icons are blocked outside. No people.
shots.narration: 盖住它，就隔绝了氧气。

shots.section_title: 小火：扣上盖子隔绝空气
shots.scene: 火三角缺了一边，火焰图标熄灭
shots.prompt_en: The fire triangle diagram with one side removed and the flame icon going out. No people.
shots.narration: 去掉三角形任何一边，火就灭了。

shots.scene: 小研从墙上取下灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lifts a fire extinguisher off its wall bracket.
shots.narration: 火大一些，就要用灭火器。

shots.scene: 几种灭火器图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: A row of different fire extinguisher icons with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 灭火器有好几种，按实验室配置选。

shots.scene: 干粉灭火器旁，活泼金属火图标被单独圈出并打叉
shots.prompt_en: A dry powder extinguisher icon; beside it a burning metal icon is circled and marked with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 常用的干粉灭火器，不能扑活泼金属火。

shots.scene: 实验室每个房间都有灭火器的平面示意图
shots.prompt_en: A simple floor plan of several lab rooms, each with a fire extinguisher icon. No people.
shots.narration: 按规定，每间实验室都要配灭火器。

shots.scene: 小研提起灭火器，拔掉保险销
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds the extinguisher upright and pulls out the safety pin.
shots.narration: 第一步，拔掉保险销。

shots.scene: 喷管对准火焰根部的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of the extinguisher nozzle aimed low at the base of a flame. No people.
shots.narration: 第二步，喷管对准火焰根部。

shots.scene: 手压下压把
shots.prompt_en: A hand squeezes the extinguisher handle firmly. No people.
shots.narration: 第三步，用力压下压把。

shots.scene: 喷射粉雾沿火焰根部左右扫动
shots.prompt_en: A spray of powder sweeps side to side along the base of a small flame. No people.
shots.narration: 第四步，沿着火焰根部左右扫。

shots.section_title: 听老师指挥，自己也要会
shots.scene: 老周拿着灭火器站在前面，学生们在后方
shots.prompt_en: The older man holds a fire extinguisher at the front while students stand back behind him.
shots.narration: 实验室起火，一般由老师来灭火。
overlay: 听老师指挥，自己也要会

shots.section_title: 听老师指挥，自己也要会
shots.scene: 阿杰在培训中练习握持灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The young male student practices holding an extinguisher during a training session with the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 但你也要会用，以防万一。

shots.section_title: 听老师指挥，自己也要会
shots.scene: 老周向学生做手势分配任务
shots.prompt_en: The older man gestures to the students, assigning each a task.
shots.narration: 该做什么、要不要你灭火，听老师安排。

shots.scene: 奔跑的着火小人图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a running person with flames on the clothing, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 衣服着火，千万别跑。

shots.scene: 小人就地躺倒翻滚压灭火焰的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person dropping to the floor and rolling to smother flames on the clothing. No people.
shots.narration: 就地躺下打滚，压灭火焰。

shots.scene: 紧急喷淋图标和灭火毯图标
shots.prompt_en: An emergency shower icon and a fire blanket icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 也可以用紧急喷淋或灭火毯。

shots.scene: 带电仪器冒火的图标，旁边电源开关被关掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a burning electrical instrument, with a power switch being turned off beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 电器起火，先切断电源。

shots.scene: 金属着火图标上的水滴被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of water being sprayed on a burning metal, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 金属着火，不能用水。

shots.scene: 火势变大，小人转身撤离的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a fire growing large while a person pictogram turns away and heads to an exit sign. No people.
shots.narration: 火势变大或拿不准，立即撤离报警。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着电话，旁边浮现119和120
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a telephone, with two large blank number cards floating beside it.
shots.narration: 着火拨打119，有人受伤拨打120。

shots.scene: 阿杰打电话，旁边地点、物质、伤员三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student speaks on a phone; three icons float beside him: a location pin, a chemical bottle and an injured person.
shots.narration: 说清地点、什么物质、有没有人受伤。

shots.scene: 报告链条图标：实验室负责人—学院—保卫处
shots.prompt_en: Three linked icons in a chain: a lab room, a department building and a security office badge. No people.
shots.narration: 同时报告实验室负责人、学院和保卫处。

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员接听电话，记录信息
shots.prompt_en: The security officer answers a phone at a duty desk and writes on a blank log sheet.
shots.narration: 保卫处接报后，会协调救援。

shots.section_title: 撤离前：关电关气拉视窗
shots.scene: 老周在门口示意大家撤离
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands at the door and signals everyone to evacuate.
shots.narration: 少数情况，需要撤离实验室。
overlay: 撤离前：关电关气拉视窗

shots.section_title: 撤离前：关电关气拉视窗
shots.scene: 阿杰关掉电热板电源，关上燃气阀
shots.prompt_en: The young male student switches off a hot plate and turns off the gas valve on the bench.
shots.narration: 安全的话，关掉电器和燃气。

shots.section_title: 撤离前：关电关气拉视窗
shots.scene: 小研拉下通风柜视窗
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pulls down the sash of a fume hood.
shots.narration: 在通风柜操作的，拉下视窗，然后离开。

shots.scene: 走廊里的安全出口标志，学生们沿箭头有序走出
shots.prompt_en: Students walk calmly in a line along a corridor following an emergency exit sign and direction arrows.
shots.narration: 沿疏散路线有序撤离，不乘电梯。

shots.scene: 楼外空地上的紧急集合点标志，学生们集合
shots.prompt_en: Students gather outdoors under an emergency assembly point sign.
shots.narration: 到紧急集合点集合。

shots.scene: 老周拿空白名单清点人数
shots.prompt_en: The older man counts the students with a blank roster in hand.
shots.narration: 清点人数，有人没到马上报告。

shots.scene: 走回楼里的小人图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person walking back into the building, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 没有通知，任何人不许返回。

shots.scene: 阿杰去医院，小研递上试剂瓶标签照片和空白说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands a blank safety data sheet and a photo of the bottle label to the young male student as he leaves for the clinic.
shots.narration: 就医时，带上化学品名称和说明书。

shots.scene: 医生图标看着空白说明书点头
shots.prompt_en: A doctor icon reading a blank safety data sheet and nodding. No people.
shots.narration: 医生知道是什么，才能对症处理。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在应急设施墙前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a wall with an eyewash station, a safety shower and a fire extinguisher.
shots.narration: 应急准备，需要事先想清楚。

shots.scene: 学生们在王老师带领下练习
shots.prompt_en: Students practice emergency responses with the safety administrator leading the session.
shots.narration: 临场不慌，要靠培训和练习。

shots.scene: 四个台阶图标全部亮起，小人和建筑图标被盾牌保护
shots.prompt_en: Four step icons all lit up, with a shield protecting a person pictogram and a building icon. No people.
shots.narration: 做好四步，把伤害降到最低。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白事故报告单，阿杰在旁讲述
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a blank incident report form while the young male student describes what happened.
shots.narration: 事故和险情，都要如实上报。

shots.scene: 现场拉起警戒线，旁边相机图标
shots.prompt_en: A spill area cordoned off with barrier tape, with a camera icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 保护现场，配合调查。

shots.scene: 原因、措施、复查三个图标依次打勾
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a magnifying glass, a wrench and a checklist. No people.
shots.narration: 查明原因，整改落实，防止再犯。

shots.scene: 老李测试紧急喷淋，记录在空白检查表上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tests an emergency shower and records it on a blank inspection sheet.
shots.narration: 洗眼器、喷淋要定期点检。

shots.scene: 灭火器压力表指针在绿区，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of a fire extinguisher pressure gauge with the needle in the green zone and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 灭火器压力正常，通道不被堵住。

shots.scene: 全楼师生参加疏散演练
shots.prompt_en: Teachers and students take part in an evacuation drill, walking out of the building in order.
shots.narration: 按学校安排，参加应急演练。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现碎玻璃箱和吸附材料图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a broken glass box and absorbent material.
shots.narration: 碎玻璃先隔离，洒漏报告老师。

shots.scene: 洗眼器、水槽、紧急喷淋三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: an eyewash station, a sink with running water and an emergency shower. No people.
shots.narration: 溅到身上，立即大量清水冲洗。

shots.scene: 火三角、烧杯盖火、灭火器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of the fire triangle, an inverted beaker over a flame and a fire extinguisher. No people.
shots.narration: 小火隔绝空气，大火会用灭火器。

shots.scene: 电话、集合点、报告单图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a telephone, an assembly point sign and a blank report form. No people.
shots.narration: 报警119和120，撤到集合点，如实上报。

shots.scene: 欣欣和小研、阿杰站在应急设施墙前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the female graduate student and the young male student wave goodbye in front of the emergency equipment wall.
shots.narration: 有准备就不慌，安全实验，下次见！
